name: Genetically Associated Process Decreased Without An Aspect Requirement (Full Descendant Control)
plain_language_rule: Predict treatment when The drug causally changes the biological process in the decreased direction; no object-aspect qualifier is required because the endpoint is itself a biological process The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.; The biological process has a forward genetic association to the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:genetic_association. At least one primary source must be infores:geneticskp. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.
hypothesis: Recorded CTD process effects have explicit causal direction but lack object-aspect values; this formulation tests that evidence directly.

nodes.role: Biological process genetically associated with disease
nodes.explanation: Biological process genetically associated with disease.

edges.subject: chemical
edges.explanation: The drug causally changes the biological process in the decreased direction; no object-aspect qualifier is required because the endpoint is itself a biological process The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.

edges.subject: process
edges.explanation: The biological process has a forward genetic association to the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:genetic_association. At least one primary source must be infores:geneticskp. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.

mechanism.rationale: Recorded CTD process effects have explicit causal direction but lack object-aspect values; this formulation tests that evidence directly. Association does not establish a corrective clinical mechanism.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[perturbation:{{relationship_types:perturbation}}]->(process:BiologicalProcess) WHERE perturbation.predicate IN {{predicates:perturbation}} AND perturbation.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND perturbation.object_direction_qualifier = "decreased" MATCH (process:BiologicalProcess)-[association:{{relationship_types:association}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE association.predicate IN {{predicates:association}} AND any(source IN ["infores:geneticskp"] WHERE source IN coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT process) AS support_count

trapi.limitations: Outside TRAPI: association: enforce primary-source membership in infores:geneticskp

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
The genetic pathway association lacks a sign and may represent enrichment rather than a causal process effect.
The full affects closure includes ameliorates_condition and is classified as treatment-using even if no such edge satisfies the other constraints in this graph.
